source: UCI 224, Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset, DOI 10.24432/C5RP6W. One physical sensor array followed over time, 128 supplied features. Chosen from metadata before acquisition or evaluation. Publicly obtainable labels. No public preregistration.
split: Chronological. Fit reference on batches 1-5 together, use batch 6 for compact Gain and four voting panels, batch 7 as the independent chronological guard, batches 8-10 for forward testing. Guard comparisons use models fitted on batches 1-6. All final predictors use 1-7. No test-time adaptation or normalization. All six classes must occur in pooled fit, proposal and guard or stop. Test metrics average over observed classes only if any are absent.
reference: Use existing CPU 100-round depth-4 XGBClassifier, seed 20421, one thread, no tuning. Use original features with split-local median imputation. Compact Gain, original separating minimum with four panels, and random-size-matched minimum use the same full model, common panels and anchor. Original fit/rank separation. One usual random-family draw at fold index zero.
challengers: From the separating stopping support, remove one feature maximizing the minimum yes count over the original family versus the fixed anchor. Break ties by removing weakest original Gain feature. Verify equivalence of lazy and eager maximizers. Compare weakest Gain feature dropped from the SAME stopping support. Singletons are retained. At stage 7 test each candidate against the reference anchor via independent refits. If it satisfies the 3% relative AUC+accuracy threshold, select it, else fall back to stop support if it independently passes, else anchor. The independent stopping-support guard uses the same rule. Report conditional challenger and no-guard supports, guard gate and outcomes unchanged by following scores.
controls: Native scikit-learn RFE with the same CPU XGBoost, 20% step on all 1-7 rows, at the unguarded vote and unguarded challenger widths; Gain prefix at vote width from original order. Native SelectKBest f_classif at fixed ceil(0.10*128)=13 and 32 columns using all 1-7 rows. Conditional widths supplied by voting, timer excludes cost of discovering width.
primary: Mean over the three named time batches of present-class macro recall (balanced accuracy). Secondary per-batch accuracy, macro one-versus-rest AUC over evaluable classes, retained width, observed charged component times and gate outcomes. No independent-site or person inference. Paired comparisons maximin_guard versus weak_gain_guard and vote_guard reported descriptively, including ties; no p-values.
blind: Obtain archive and complete source hash. The fit worker discards the first field on future batch lines without converting it to labels. A separate scoring step accesses the first fields after all supports and prediction arrays are persisted and checksummed. All data, training rules, methods and comparisons fixed before observing any external model results. No test-score tuning. One-hour worker limit.
